definition: A document issued by the Government of Quebec, required alongside a study permit for most students planning to study in Quebec. It replaces the provincial attestation letter that other provinces and territories issue.
longform: It is obtained through a separate application to the Government of Quebec, distinct from both the institution's letter of acceptance and the federal study permit application.
